subject.title: [Bug]: Fresh LM Studio session on Ubuntu fails with "Context overflow" or "Message ordering conflict" after first message

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee a usable first turn for discovered 8K LM Studio models by dynamically fitting optional bootstrap/tool payloads, or define and surface a supported minimum context requirement for agent sessions?
rationale: The report is a bug under the existing provider contract, but the durable remedy changes the product policy for how much agent bootstrap capability must be preserved on very small local-model contexts.

options.title: Budget the first prompt dynamically
options.body: Preserve the existing LM Studio route by calculating the effective context budget before the first turn and removing only optional prompt/tool material until the request fits.

options.title: Expose a minimum-context diagnostic
options.body: Keep the full bootstrap contract but fail setup or the first turn with a clear message stating the required context and the exact configuration/server setting to change.

recommendation.title: Budget the first prompt dynamically
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing LM Studio route by calculating the effective context budget before the first turn and removing only optional prompt/tool material until the request fits.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged small-context budget work is the closest feature history and provides the relevant design context.
